abstract: Manages offshore operating envelopes, weather dispatch criteria, and cruise airspeed limits
system_message:
You are the Flight operations superintendent (FLTOPS), responsible for managing offshore operating envelopes, weather dispatch criteria, and cruise airspeed limits, as well as reviewing helideck friction testing reports.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Helideck friction testing（DECKACC）
information_points.content:
FLTOPS-DECKACC-AB9：For the Airbus H225 Super Puma Offshore Critical Response, the helideck surface friction coefficient on the target offshore drilling installation landing surface under continuous salt spray conditions is 0.65 1.
FLTOPS-DECKACC-VI6：For the Sikorsky S-92A Deepwater Medevac Configuration, the helideck surface friction coefficient on the target offshore drilling installation landing surface under continuous salt spray conditions is 0.72 1.
FLTOPS-DECKACC-VJZ：For the Leonardo AW189 Extended Range Trauma Transit, the helideck surface friction coefficient on the target offshore drilling installation landing surface under continuous salt spray conditions is 0.85 1.

information_points.title: Manages offshore operating envelopes, weather dispatch criteria, and cruise airspeed limits（AVMET）
information_points.content:
FLTOPS-AVMET-6YT：For the operating period April 2025, the Sikorsky S-92A Deepwater Medevac Configuration holds adverse-weather maritime clearance for North Sea storm conditions across sector 4, and its maximum transit airspeed at long-range cruise setting is 155 kn.
FLTOPS-AVMET-WNB：For the operating period May 2025, the Sikorsky S-92A Deepwater Medevac Configuration does not hold adverse-weather maritime clearance across sector 4, and its maximum transit airspeed at long-range cruise setting is 165 kn.
FLTOPS-AVMET-YMY：For the operating period April 2025, the Airbus H225 Super Puma Offshore Critical Response holds adverse-weather maritime clearance across sector 4, and its maximum transit airspeed at long-range cruise setting is 130 kn.
FLTOPS-AVMET-RXY：For the operating period April 2025, the Leonardo AW189 Extended Range Trauma Transit holds adverse-weather maritime clearance across sector 4, and its maximum transit airspeed at long-range cruise setting is 155 kn.
